source.subject: Illegal entry to Hotel including JCruz

document.filename: ENTRADA ILEGAL DE CAM Y JOAN CRUZ AL HOTEL SUN PARK - 01MAR2018.pdf

source_text_status.filename_association: The filename expressly includes CAM Y JOAN CRUZ and the date 01MAR2018.
source_text_status.page_caption: The repeated page caption names Jose Acosta Matos and characterises the entry as illegal and as forcing the staff door on 01/03/18.
source_text_status.attribution_boundary: The repository records the words 'ilegal' / 'illegal' as the source's own label, not as an adjudicated legal conclusion. The page captions themselves name Jose Acosta Matos; they do not independently identify Joan Cruz in text.

identity_context.boundary: The surviving public corporate-power record does not prove that any power was exercised at Sun Park on 01-Mar-2018.

later_public_context.fact: Hosteltur material identifies Joan Cruz among Tusity's partners and separately lists Grupo Acosta Matos among businesses supported by Tusity.
later_public_context.boundary: Later commercial context; not proof of a 2018 agreement or coordination.

later_public_context.fact: Tourinews reports BLUESEA engaging Joan Cruz in the integration of Meeting Point Hotels Spain and renewal of hotel-management contracts.

related_web_evidence.statement: Recovered original HKI Hotels website captures show Sun Park (Lanzarote) in the firm's projects section and Joan Cruz on the firm's team page in the captured website state of 25-Nov-2019.
related_web_evidence.boundary: This later website state does not by itself establish that the listing existed on 01-Mar-2018 or 07-Jun-2018, nor any contract, mandate, court authorisation, coordination or illegality.

epistemic_guardrails: No facial recognition is used to identify people in the 18-page photographic PDF.
A filename association is not treated as proof of conduct, knowledge, authority, coordination or criminal responsibility.
The PDF metadata date of 10-Aug-2018 is treated as a later document-compilation date, not as the date of the depicted event.
The 15-Jan-2026 email date is a custody/preservation date, not the historical event date.
The 25-Nov-2019 HKI website capture is treated as later continuity evidence and is not backdated to 2018 without separate evidence.
